_comment: Owner-confirmed rebalance/deploy log for the agentic cash account (••••3900). The agent APPENDS one record per confirmed deploy/rebalance (see AGENTIC.md); build-data.mjs grades each vs live quotes + SPY and attaches it as data.agentic.decisions for the consumer's Rebalance Log card. priceAt = the fill price; spyAt = SPY at decision time (null = not recorded, e.g. the seed → graded on absolute return only).

decisions.rationale: Owner-confirmed deploy of the weekly research refresh (7-name target: JPM 16% / SPY 18% / NVDA 15% / V 15% / AAPL 15% / GOOGL 10% / UNH 11%). Account cash-constrained ($10.35 available) — only the gaps under the new target with room in cash were funded: V, AAPL, UNH. GOOGL/JPM/SPY already at/above target, no buy needed. NVDA deferred (wash-sale — loss booked 2026-08-03, rebuy blocked to 2026-09-03). Orders placed market-closed (~1:16 AM ET) as fractional dollar-market buys, queued for the 9:30 AM ET regular-session open — priceAt below is the order-time reference quote, not a confirmed fill.

Deployed the added cash after a fresh research refresh (adversarial verify passed only LLY/JPM/NVDA as buys). Earnings-blackout deferred MSFT (7/29) and V (7/28); AMZN dropped from the target; GOOGL held near target. LLY/GE/SPY/NVDA filled at the 9:30 open (actual fills below). JPM (14% target) still PENDING: the owner's manual $285 order mis-filled as IBM; IBM was sold same-day (~+$2, avg 201.17) and JPM will be bought 2026-07-24 once the IBM proceeds settle (T+1, cash account) — append it to this decision then.

Initial deployment of the agentic cash account into the first research target — 8-name sector-diversified basket (SPY ballast + megacap quality). Seed record: entries are the account's actual average cost basis; SPY benchmark not recorded at seed time (absolute-return grading only).

Owner-confirmed ticket 2026-08-10-61kjns (turnover $3,744.55, above the $500 auto tier). Leg 1 placed 2026-08-10: full exits of four off-target names (GE, LLY, AMZN, MSFT — losses-first ordering, all four were short-term gains) raising $2158.2 of proceeds; est. short-term realized gain $231.22, no harvestable losses so no cross-account wash check was required. Leg 2 (T+1, funded by settling proceeds) is JPM $162.93 / AAPL $795.43 / UNH $583.22 / SPY $42.85, to be placed next session after an earnings re-check. NVDA (wash-sale hold to 2026-09-02), V and GOOGL (gapped below planned entry) deferred — ~$576.71 of intended weight held back. Leg 2 placed 2026-08-11 (proceeds settled, $2,159.22 buying power): AAPL $795.43 @ $306.05, UNH $583.22 @ $404.81, JPM $162.93 @ $359.45, SPY $42.85 @ $773.51 — $1,584.43 deployed, all four filled. Earnings re-check over Aug 11-18 returned no report for any buy name, so none were dropped; all four traded inside their planned entry zones. Ticket closed (done).

Owner-confirmed ticket 2026-08-11-iy7ywv — deploy the cash left over from the 08-10 rebalance. No sells, $0 tax. Live pre-checks: book -0.41% vs plan basis; next reports NVDA 2026-08-26, V 2026-10-27, UNH 2026-10-27, so no earnings blackout. NVDA was buyable because the wash-sale ledger now rebuilds from real closing trades (lossSource=trades, empty) — the phantom loss behind the 09-02 block is gone. PLACED: NVDA $86.49 @ $216.67, UNH $1.80 @ $403.52. HELD BACK: V $436.92 — it had slipped to $362.96, below its planned $364-372 entry, which is the planner's own below-entry deferral rule (it was $364.32 when the plan was built); re-proposes when it trades back in the zone. GOOGL still deferred below entry.

Pre-authorized post-deposit deployment (ticket 2026-08-12-1aqszr, owner 2026-08-11: research builds the model -> legitimizer -> trade -> excess parks in VTI). Sold the three names the split-verdict target dropped (AAPL -9.07, UNH -1.02, V +12.57 — net ST +2.48), then deployed 7223.71 across the 9-name target. NVDA deferred by the v105 cross-account wash guard (margin-book NVDA loss 2026-07-29, blocked to 2026-08-28) — its 320.53 PARKED in VTI, first live use of the waiting ground; released to fund NVDA when the window clears. Pre-checks: book +0.10% vs basis; all buy names report late Oct; no margin AAPL buy in 30d (loss-sale wash-clean); no same-day orders (PDT clear). Proceeds ran 6.89 under plan; the park leg absorbed the shave — never exceeded the ticket.

Owner-confirmed ticket 2026-08-25-2m67b0 — deploy 1380.37 of settled cash into the 08-25 target. No sells, 0 tax. Pre-checks: book -0.11% vs plan basis; JNJ reports 10-13 and KO 10-20 (no blackout); no loss-sales so no cross-account wash check; no same-day orders (PDT clear). Deferred and NOT bought: MA + BKNG (above their entry bands) and V (14d re-entry cooldown, clears 08-26) — 1821.56 of intended weight held, no parking leg emitted this pass. JPM/GE phase-out exits stayed blocked by the 14d min-hold (churn governor).

Two-strike phase-out completes: JPM and GE exit after failing to return from adversarial verify a second consecutive cycle — the exits the 08-25 ticket computed but could not place, held one day short of the 14d min-hold (both bought 08-12). Proceeds fund the defensive floor (JNJ 7.13%, KO 6.65%) and the gold diversifier sleeve (GLDM 5.0%), with AMZN topped to target. $1,028.66 of deferred weight for MA, V and BKNG (all above-entry) parks in VTI rather than sitting in cash. Realized ST: +$2.68 JPM gain, -$24.06 GE loss, net -$21.38.

Waiting-ground release: BKNG traded back into its entry band (spot $205.94 vs a $203.76 ceiling + 2% premium), so $543.61 of the VTI placeholder parked on 08-26 was sold to fund the position at its full 4.75% target weight. Realized +$1.78 ST on the release. MA and V stay above-entry and keep $485.99 parked. The VTI trim the target also called for ($6.30) is held by the 14d min-hold to 2026-09-09 — dust either way.

Waiting-ground release funds MA and V, the last two names parked above-entry since 08-26. Released 1.209649 VTI @ 377.035 = $456.05 (-$1.00 ST). CAVEAT: both names gapped up overnight and filled OUTSIDE their entry bands (MA $588.82 vs a $584.33 ceiling+tolerance, V $378.30 vs $372.50) — they cleared only because the target is 9 days stale and the zones went advisory past ENTRY_ZONE_STALE_DAYS. Overshoot ~$2-4 on $455. The weekly research has not refreshed since 08-25; its Routine exits in ~2 minutes without producing a target.

Deployed the account’s full $1,817.29 idle cash across ten underweight target names, largest gap first. No sells: nothing was off-target, over weight, or harvestable, so turnover is entirely new money. MA and V were the two largest gaps (1.7%/1.6% against 5% targets) after the 09-02 partial funding; SPY, JNJ, KO, VTI and GLDM top up the ballast/defensive/gold sleeves. Gate printed EXEC_AUTO at $1,817.29 turnover, well inside the $10,000 auto tier. Pre-checks clean: book $13,290.31 vs $13,312.49 plan basis (-0.17%), buying power exactly $1,817.29, every name’s next earnings >7d out, no cross-account wash exposure (the margin book’s last 30 days is PLTR/CIFR/TSM only), no intraday buys so PDT is untouched. The plan’s single warning is expected and correct: the buys were re-sized $1,849.47 → $1,817.29 because the $32.18 shortfall was under the $100 parking floor, so the waiting ground was left alone rather than forced into a dust sale.

First MANDATE A rebalance (target asOf 2026-09-09, 18 names). Funded entirely by trimming SPY from 17.2% to its 4.5% residual weight — the mandate retires structural index ballast, so $1,675.27 of the core was rotated into single names the research picked. Buys: JPM $546.28 (new, 0 → 7.96%), UNP $347.26 (new, 0 → 5.06%), AAPL $322.55 (new, 0 → 4.70%), V $292.19 (4.4% → 8.62%), NVDA $154.49 (7.2% → 9.41%). Turnover $3,338.04, inside the $10,000 auto tier; est. short-term tax net +$0.51 on the SPY trim (essentially flat — the lot was days old). Pre-checks clean: live book $13,186.80 vs $13,160.28 plan basis (+0.20%), buying power $1,675.16 after the sell filled versus $1,662.77 of buys, no buy name reporting earnings within 7 days, no ••••3900 orders earlier today so PDT is untouched, and the margin book's last 30 days of realized losses are CIFR/TSM only — no cross-account wash exposure on any buy name. META ($618.53 of intended weight) was deferred above-entry: $651.70 is 3.3% over the $600-$630 research zone, so the dollars wait in CASH rather than the VTI waiting ground (an undated deferral clears on a price move, and a short round trip costs more in spread than a few days of beta). Buys were re-sized $1,694.72 → $1,662.77 because the $19.45 shortfall sat under the $100 parking floor, so the waiting ground was left alone rather than forced into a dust sale; $12.50 left uninvested. Book drawdown -3.6% from its 08-10 peak against SPY -0.4%, i.e. -3.2pp relative — inside the -5pp soft tier, deployment normal.
